input.quote: 5.2 The Company shall have exclusive artistic and editorial control over the Site, including, without limitation, the implementation of the Content on the Site and the design and look and feel of the Site.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no intellectual property or data ownership provision anywhere. HDI designs, develops and hosts the Site (§1.1-1.3) using Content we supply (§2.1), yet the only proprietary-rights language is our editorial control over the Site (§5.2), the trademark licence to HDI (§6.1) and confidentiality (§8), none of which allocates ownership of the developed Site, of work product, or of our Content, customer and user data, and none of which gives us any licence to the deliverables. That fails both the preferred and fallback positions, so we insert a single short Section 5.5: we own the deliverables with an assignment from HDI, HDI retains its pre-existing IP and grants us a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to any embedded HDI IP, we retain all rights in Company Data with HDI's licence limited to processing it solely to provide the services, and there is no joint ownership. The carve-out for our own approval under §7.1 avoids contradicting the consent-gated reciprocal cross-promotion e-mail list mechanic that benefits us.

proposal.summary: Insert new Section 5.5 allocating ownership of the Site deliverables and Company Data to the Company, with HDI retaining pre-existing IP and granting an embedded-IP licence.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement is silent on ownership of the Site we fund and of our Content and customer data, so we have added a short ownership clause: we own the deliverables (HDI assigns them), HDI keeps its pre-existing IP and licenses any embedded IP to us on a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free basis, we retain all rights in Company Data with HDI's use limited to providing the services, and nothing is jointly owned.

ops.text: 5.5 Ownership. The Company owns all deliverables and work product created for the Company under this Agreement, including the Site (the "Deliverables"), and HDI hereby assigns to the Company all right, title and interest in the Deliverables and such work product. HDI retains its pre-existing intellectual property and grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to use any HDI intellectual property embedded in the Deliverables. The Company retains all right, title and interest in all Content and all customer, user and transaction data belonging to, supplied by or processed for the Company in connection with the Site ("Company Data"), and, except as the Company approves under Section 7.1, any license of HDI in Company Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the services under this Agreement. No intellectual property is owned jointly by the Parties.
